title: Sappho 1 — Ποικιλόθρον' ἀθανάτ Ἀφρόδιτα (Hymn to Aphrodite)
author: Sappho of Lesbos
license: Public domain (Greek source; preserved in full quotation by Dionysius of Halicarnassus, De Compositione Verborum 23)
constitutional_role: The most complete surviving Sapphic poem. Anchor of the Zenith movement in Day and Night. The cletic hymn: invocation, narrative of past epiphany, present plea. The only surviving Sapphic verse in which Sappho names herself (Ψάπφ', voc., stanza 5).

authoritative_english_translation.source_collection: Day and Night: Conversations with Sapphic Desire
